note: Corps of Engineers campground on Rend Lake's east shore near Whittington, four wooded loops (Nighthawk, Blue, Cardinal, Eagle). Loops sit in oak-hickory woods back from a riprapped shore; Blue and Cardinal end on open points over the lake. Boat ramp at the adjoining Gun Creek day-use area. Every camper registers at the gate on arrival. --Claude
